BI-SEQ-01 sequence Web lead enrichment and disposition

Obtain seller-reported polymer, form, source and samples; Compare observations without collapsing contradictory facts; Request suitable material test if uncertain; Maintain unknown as unknown; Return draft questions and risks, not verified identity
BI-SEQ-02 sequence Material identity and inspection

Resolve active opportunity and lot snapshot; Verify material, load quantity and economics source; Separate seller ask from current buyer bid; Check current delivery and payment terms; Present uncertainty and options for broker review; Use native offer owner for any draft/issuance
BI-SEQ-03 sequence Opportunity to draft-quote readiness

Start from approved material/opportunity snapshot; Initiate canonical Gate match via Odoo; CEG executes hard gates and scoring; Persist match run and result with lineage; Human reviews candidate buyers; Owner creates draft offers where authorized
BI-SEQ-04 sequence Buyer-fit inquiry and offer selection

Capture exact buyer refusal and subject; Treat rejection vocabulary as a proposed interpretation; Check measured spec and buyer-specific evidence; Offer clarifying questions and conditional recovery options; Broker confirms reason and appropriate next commercial action; Keep provenance without automatic permanent exclusion
BI-SEQ-05 sequence Rejected offer / match recovery

Observe discrepancy as report or test, with source; Determine which original/lot and spec revision it belongs to; Propose further inspection or hold to authorized operator; Retain earlier approved evidence, add a successor if corrected; Apply native verification or claim decision under existing owner
BI-SEQ-06 sequence Quality deviation and evidence review

Identify actual load, weight basis and route; Check capacity, carrier and current schedule evidence; Propose alternatives, with uncertain costs explicit; Request approved logistics action and document it; Do not represent scheduling advice as physical dispatch

Record supplier-reported material stream and frequency; Distinguish current inventory from recurring capability; Request samples, photos and quality/volume verification; Document unresolved source risks; Have broker admit any marketable opportunity via native workflow
BI-SEQ-08 sequence Supplier and repeat-stream qualification

Read current native offer terms and expiration; Identify the precise disagreement and affected parties; Generate nonbinding options using only source-backed inputs; Broker chooses amendments via offer owner; Record actual counterparty response separately
BI-SEQ-09 sequence Terms negotiation and exceptions

Read document requirements for the specific operation; Identify missing originals and associations; Classify/OCR without implying verification; Route to authorized document reviewer; Return state of verification and unresolved gaps
BI-SEQ-10 sequence Material and shipment evidence readiness

Record a real broker task and approved outcome; Match observed case to a candidate coaching scenario; Surface source and unverified SOP status; Human resolves applicable owner/process; Label scenario and add to frozen evaluation only after review; Use feedback to propose knowledge revision, not change business fact
BI-SEQ-11 sequence Broker coaching and review-driven improvement

Observe a product/process clue and source; Retrieve relevant technical candidate from PP KB; Form a hypothesis of likely scrap type; Request verifying material evidence; Never promote hypothesis to current supply or buyer requirement
